Probably the compound is something like "C6H5CH2CH3" (ethylbenzene) which has 4 types: aromatic protons (5 equivalent? actually 5 aromatic protons not all equivalent due to substitution), benzylic CH2, methyl CH3. Aromatic protons in ethylbenzene are not all equivalent: ortho, meta, para positions differ. So maybe 4 types.

But uncertain.

Better to ask for SMILES via function? Could we call retrieve_protons_shifts? That returns ranges, not structure.
